# Kuldeepsinh Jadeja

> Portfolio of Kuldeepsinh Jadeja (also Kuldeep Jadeja), a Full-Stack Engineer at Meetanshi Technologies in India who builds e-commerce and AI-enabled web apps with React, Next.js and Node.js.

## Key Facts

- Name: Kuldeepsinh Jadeja (also written Kuldeep Jadeja)
- Role: Full-Stack Engineer at Meetanshi Technologies (https://meetanshi.com), July 2026 to present
- Based in: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Experience: professional web development since 2022
- Previous roles: Full Stack Engineer at Redlio Designs (Jul 2024 to Jul 2026); Frontend Developer at Salecto India (Jun 2022 to Jun 2024, Magento 2 storefronts for European brands)
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Marwadi University (2019 to 2022)
- Core stack: React, Next.js (SSR/SSG), Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, GraphQL, REST APIs, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- Specialities: JWT/RBAC authentication, Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse tuning (raised scores by 20 to 35 points on two production projects), Magento 2 theming, LLM pipelines
- Availability: open to Full-Stack and React/Next.js roles (on-site, hybrid or remote)

## Projects

- [Award Winning Slider](https://kuldeepjadeja.dev/readme/AwardWinningSlider): Image carousel with synchronized text animations built with JavaScript, jQuery, Slick Carousel and GSAP.
- [Self-Hosted File Server](https://kuldeepjadeja.dev/readme/clipper-file-server): Node.js and Express file server with a Flmngr web interface for managing files.
- [Python Background Remover](https://kuldeepjadeja.dev/readme/Image-Background-Remover): FastAPI service using Rembg and ONNX Runtime to remove image backgrounds.
- [Portfolio Website](https://kuldeepjadeja.dev/readme/portfolio_website): Source and notes for this Next.js portfolio site.
- Automated Twitch Clipper: Detects viral Twitch moments, generates clips and posts them as Shorts to Instagram and YouTube (Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, FFmpeg). Private for now.
